title: Home practical guide and safety card: melting race
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Changes of materials and animals including humans
source: Written for science/y5 lesson 19 (Home practical guide and safety card: melting race (portal worksheet; warm tap water only, adult handles anything hot))
intro: Lesson 19: Reversible changes: melting and freezing. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out which place melts an ice cube fastest
equipment: Four ice cubes the same size
Warm tap water (adult handles anything hot)
safety: Warm tap water only, adult handles anything hot
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Put one ice cube on each saucer
Place them: fridge, kitchen table, sunny windowsill, in a bowl of warm tap water
Record the time each cube takes to melt completely

questions.q: Big question: is set chocolate still chocolate?
questions.a: Yes: it only changed state, so it is reversible.
